text: Slate automatically selects the best AI model for each task
quote: Slate automatically selects the right model for the job.

text: Slate can sustain long, multi-hour interactive sessions with the user
quote: Slate works with you across long, multi-hour sessions.

text: Slate can parallelize and orchestrate many tasks/agents at once
quote: Parallelize working and orchestration of many tasks at once.

text: Slate is installable as a global npm CLI package
quote: npm i -g @randomlabs/slate

text: Onboarding lets you choose your model source, including existing ChatGPT/Codex or SuperGrok subscriptions
quote: Onboarding asks for your terminal background, multiline input preference, and model source: your ChatGPT/Codex subscription, SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits.

text: Slate can analyze a whole codebase's architecture and produce a written architecture document with improvement suggestions
quote: Please review the architecture of my entire codebase creating an ARCH.md and then give me ways I can improve it.

text: A /sessions command lets you switch between existing sessions
quote: Use `/sessions` to switch between existing sessions

text: Pressing Tab queues a message to run automatically after the current turn finishes
quote: Press Tab to queue the current message so it runs after the current turn finishes.

text: Shell commands can be executed directly from the session using '!'
quote: Execute shell commands directly with `!`

text: You can reference specific files in a message using @filename syntax
quote: Use `@filename` references

text: A /workspace command opens a manager to review and remove workspace directories
quote: Use `/workspace` to open the workspace manager, where you can review and remove workspace directories.

text: Running subagents are displayed as a grid of inline cards, one per agent
quote: Those agents show up as a grid of inline subagent cards, one per agent.

text: While agents run in the background, you can keep chatting, queue more tasks, or spin up additional agents in parallel
quote: While one or more agents run in the background, you can keep talking with Slate: plan next steps, queue up additional tasks, or spin up more agents to parallelize work across several tasks at once.

text: Slate ships built-in user-facing workflows ('goal' and 'deep-research') usable without authoring them yourself
quote: `goal` and `deep-research` are built-in programs. They are user-visible workflows, not something you need to author before using Slate.

text: Slate applies agent rules from multiple sources in a defined precedence order
quote: Slate by default respects agent rules in the following order

text: Slate can perform integration tests manually, a capability few agents support
quote: Slate is one of the few agents capable of performing integration tests manually.

text: Skills are markdown packages that give the agent domain-specific knowledge and behavior
quote: Skills are markdown instruction packages that give the agent domain-specific knowledge and behavior.

text: A built-in skill can generate distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces
quote: description: "Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces."

text: Slate supports Claude Code's .claude/skills/ format for compatibility
quote: `.claude/skills/` | Claude Code compatibility

text: Permissions can be configured per action (allow/ask/deny) or via fine-grained pattern objects
quote: Each permission key maps to an action ("allow", "ask", or "deny"), or a pattern object for fine-grained control.

text: You can set preferred default models per slot via /models dialog or config file
quote: Set preferred default models for each slot with the `/models` dialog or `slate.json` under `models`.

text: A flag exists to bypass permission prompts entirely for the agent
quote: We support `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (alias: `--yolo`) to bypass permission prompts.

text: Bug reports automatically include diagnostic info like OS, version, and session context
quote: Slate automatically attaches relevant diagnostic information (OS, version, session context) to your report.

text: A keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+X then N) starts a new session
quote: Ctrl+X then N New session
